extra.text: A rain shelter for the seed archive needs living material that will not sour the work. Bring four livingwood and four livingrock.
Your first verified completion counts as Lamplighters civic service. Joining the guild is optional.

accept.text: Only a small frame is planned. Eight sound pieces are enough.

decline.text: Then let the work wait. No living bargain is improved by reluctant hands.

in_progress.text: Return four livingwood and four livingrock to the steward who measured the shelter.

ready.text: The grain is awake and the stone rings clear.

extra.text: These pieces will become the archive's frame. You supplied exactly what the design can honor.
The Lamplighters will remember your service. Ask a guild contact about introductions and workshop commissions.
